cases.title: Add new bookmark into a specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added into a specific designated location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from file and all access points
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are properly deleted from the bookmarks file and no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add and delete bookmarks from the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully added to and deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into bookmarks hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch bookmark in browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Validate default bookmarks packaged with browser
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Verify bookmark item changes are saved without loss of integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add and delete bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added and deleted.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Restart and Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and persisted when the browser is restarted or follows a browser crash.

cases.title: View properties execution for bookmarks, folders, and separators negative test
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution fails or is not possible negatively for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Inline renaming of bookmarks without properties dialog
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline directly without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are properly sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show and hide bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden.

cases.title: Delete multiple bookmarks simultaneously
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be successfully deleted at one time.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself, immediate parent, or immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

opinions.feedback: All test cases map one-to-one to the provided requirements, accurately capturing the specified behaviors including additions, deletions, modifications, view behaviors, and restrictions. No redundancy, missing coverage, or blockers were identified.
